<code><nowiki>{{FactionLink}}</nowiki></code> renders a link to a faction page. The ordinary positional page-title form is the supported first-class form:

<pre>{{FactionLink|The Followers of Evil}}</pre>

The positional page title supplies the destination and the visible text. Use explicit presentation fields when they differ:

<pre>{{FactionLink
 |The Followers of Evil
 |link=The Followers of Evil
 |text=Followers of Evil
}}</pre>

The link picker may supply <code>stablekey</code>. This is the exact advanced faction identity selected by the picker. It distinguishes the catalog record from its display name. Editors normally do not need to memorize or type it. A stable-key-only form is intended for generated links:

<pre>{{FactionLink|stablekey=faction:evil}}</pre>

Generated picker output may also carry an <code>image</code> fallback. FactionLink currently renders a text link, so this metadata does not add a visible image and should normally be left unchanged.

== Parameters ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter
! Description
|-
| <code>1</code>
| Faction page and default display text. The first positional page-title parameter is the usual form.
|-
| <code>stablekey</code>
| Exact advanced faction identity selected automatically by the Erenshor link picker. Usually leave this to generated links.
|-
| <code>link</code> or <code>page</code>
| Explicit destination page.
|-
| <code>text</code>
| Visible link text.
|-
| <code>image</code>
| Picker-owned fallback image metadata. FactionLink currently renders no image.
|}
